blocks.zh: 外觀缺陷：缺陷識別、分類與目視檢查（空針）
blocks.en: Cosmetic Imperfections: Defect Identification, Classification and Visual Inspection (Unfilled Syringes)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 PFS 外觀缺陷（Cosmetic Imperfections）的範疇：僅限未充填注射器的視覺缺陷，不含尺寸、印刷或包裝缺陷。
blocks.en: Understand the scope of PFS cosmetic imperfections: visual defects of unfilled syringes only, excluding dimensional, printing or packaging defects.

blocks.zh: 掌握 PDA TR43 對缺陷分類的基本框架（Critical / Major A / Major B / Minor / N/A）及其與 AQL 的連結。
blocks.en: Master the basic framework of PDA TR43 defect classification (Critical / Major A / Major B / Minor / N/A) and its link to AQL.

blocks.zh: 說明 ICH Q9 品質風險管理方法在缺陷分類與驗證中的應用。
blocks.en: Explain how the ICH Q9 quality risk management approach is applied to defect classification and validation.

blocks.zh: 區分人工目視檢查（Manual Visual Inspection）與自動目視檢查（Automated Visual Inspection）的方法、限制與應用場景。
blocks.en: Distinguish manual visual inspection from automated visual inspection in terms of methods, limitations and application scenarios.

blocks.zh: 理解外觀缺陷如何影響最終充填容器的視覺檢查缺陷率，以及對患者安全的潛在影響。
blocks.en: Understand how cosmetic imperfections affect the visual inspection defect rate of the final filled container, and their potential impact on patient safety.

blocks.zh: 9.0 Cosmetic Imperfections 外觀缺陷
blocks.en: 9.0 Cosmetic Imperfections

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 本節範疇（Scope）: 僅涵蓋「未充填（unfilled）」玻璃注射器的視覺缺陷，包含玻璃筒身、針頭、針頭護套、活塞、活塞桿。尺寸不符、印刷缺陷、包裝缺陷均不在本節討論。充填後注射器的目視檢查見 Section 13.4。
blocks.en: Scope: This section covers only visual defects of "unfilled" glass syringes, including the glass barrel, needle, needle shield, plunger stopper and plunger rod. Dimensional deviations, printing defects and packaging defects are outside its scope. Visual inspection of filled syringes is covered in Section 13.4.

blocks.zh: 缺陷的累積效應: PFS 各零組件的外觀缺陷會累積，最終反映在充填後注射器的視覺檢查缺陷率上。未被偵測的嚴重缺陷（影響容器完整性或藥品完整性）可能導致市場上的患者安全事件。這就是為何外觀缺陷管理必須從空針（零組件）階段就開始。
blocks.en: Cumulative effect of defects: Cosmetic imperfections of the individual PFS components accumulate and are ultimately reflected in the visual inspection defect rate of the filled syringe. Undetected serious defects (those affecting container integrity or product integrity) can lead to patient safety events in the market. This is why cosmetic defect management must start at the empty syringe (component) stage.

blocks.zh:
兩大次組件類別:
- 初級組件（Primary）: 直接接觸藥品——玻璃筒身、活塞、尖端封口
- 次級組件（Secondary）: 與初級組件互動、提供使用功能——活塞桿、backstop、安全裝置
blocks.en:
Two subcomponent categories:
- Primary components: in direct contact with the drug product: glass barrel, plunger stopper, tip closure
- Secondary components: interact with the primary components and provide usability functions: plunger rod, backstop, safety device

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 PFS 想像成一支精密鋼筆的組合——墨水匣（玻璃筒身）的外觀瑕疵，加上筆尖（針頭）的彎曲，再加上筆蓋（針頭護套）的變形，三者疊加才決定了這支鋼筆最後是否「外觀合格」。每個零件的品質管控都不能掉以輕心，因為它們共同構成最終產品的外觀結果。
blocks.en: Think of a PFS as a precision fountain pen: a cosmetic flaw in the ink cartridge (glass barrel), plus a bent nib (needle), plus a deformed cap (needle shield) together determine whether the pen is finally "cosmetically acceptable". No component's quality control can be taken lightly, because they jointly make up the final cosmetic result of the product.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — Taiwan CDMO 視角
blocks.en: Key Notes: Taiwan CDMO Perspective

blocks.zh: 在 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 第 8.87 條框架下，CDMO 對充填後注射器執行 100% 目視檢查，而本節所討論的「空針外觀缺陷管理」是前段管控的基礎。供應商的 AQL 進料抽驗（Incoming Inspection）與製程中管控（In-Process Control）若能有效攔截外觀缺陷，即可降低充填後最終檢查的缺陷率，減少批次報廢風險。
blocks.en: Under PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) paragraph 8.87, a CDMO performs 100% visual inspection of filled syringes, and the "empty syringe cosmetic defect management" discussed in this section is the foundation of the upstream controls. If the supplier's AQL incoming inspection and in-process control effectively intercept cosmetic defects, the defect rate at final inspection after filling can be reduced, lowering the risk of batch rejection.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為何「未充填注射器的外觀缺陷」管理對充填後的最終目視檢查良率有直接影響？請說明其邏輯鏈。
blocks.en: Why does the management of cosmetic imperfections of unfilled syringes directly affect the yield of final visual inspection after filling? Explain the logic chain.

blocks.zh: 初級組件（Primary）與次級組件（Secondary）的外觀缺陷，對患者安全的潛在風險是否相同？請舉例說明。
blocks.en: Is the potential patient safety risk of cosmetic imperfections the same for primary and secondary components? Explain with examples.

blocks.zh: 表格解讀 Commentary
blocks.en: Table Commentary

blocks.zh: 玻璃組件（玻璃管、散裝注射器、即用型注射器）有 PDA TR43 可作為缺陷評估依據，且四個管控點均適用。橡膠組件與塑膠組件目前無藥學專用標準，需借用橡膠技術工業標準，並依藥用嚴格程度調整——這意味著 CDMO 必須與供應商共同定義並協議接受標準，而非直接套用工業標準。
blocks.en: For glass components (glass tube, bulk syringes, ready-to-use syringes), PDA TR43 serves as the basis for defect evaluation and applies at all four control points. For rubber and plastic components there is currently no pharmaceutical-specific standard, so industrial standards for rubber technology must be borrowed and adapted to the criticality of pharmaceutical use. This means the CDMO must define and agree acceptance criteria jointly with the supplier rather than applying an industrial standard directly.

blocks.zh: 9.1 Defect Identification 缺陷識別
blocks.en: 9.1 Defect Identification

blocks.zh: PDA TR43 的角色: 目前唯一針對玻璃注射器缺陷識別與分類的 PDA 技術報告，提供缺陷定義的基本框架。對於橡膠與塑膠組件，目前尚無藥學專用指引，需借用工業標準並因應藥用嚴格程度調整。
blocks.en: Role of PDA TR43: Currently the only PDA technical report on defect identification and classification for glass syringes, providing the basic framework for defect definitions. For rubber and plastic components there is no pharmaceutical-specific guidance yet; industrial standards must be borrowed and adapted to the criticality of pharmaceutical use.

blocks.zh: Limit Samples（界限樣品）: 實體樣品，展示某缺陷類型的最大可接受程度。是供應商與藥廠之間建立共識的重要工具，類似於顏色比對色卡的概念——文字描述有時無法取代實體參照物。
blocks.en: Limit samples: Physical samples showing the maximum acceptable degree of a given defect type. They are an important tool for building consensus between supplier and pharmaceutical company, similar to a color reference chart: a written description can sometimes not replace a physical reference.

blocks.zh: 對齊方法的重要性: 供應商與藥廠必須使用相同的識別方法（人工或自動），否則同一批次在供應商端通過但在藥廠進料檢查時不通過，會造成供應鏈摩擦與爭議。
blocks.en: Importance of aligned methods: Supplier and pharmaceutical company must use the same identification method (manual or automated). Otherwise, a batch that passes at the supplier but fails at the pharmaceutical company's incoming inspection will cause supply chain friction and disputes.

blocks.zh: Limit Sample 就像烹飪競賽中的「標準菜色樣品」——評審（藥廠）與參賽者（供應商）都需要先看過標準樣品，才能對「什麼是剛好可接受」達成一致的判斷。沒有這個實體參照，同樣的缺陷，不同的人可能做出截然不同的判定。
blocks.en: A limit sample is like the "standard dish sample" in a cooking competition: the judges (pharmaceutical company) and the contestants (supplier) must both see the standard sample first to reach a consistent judgement on what is "just acceptable". Without this physical reference, different people may reach very different judgements on the same defect.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — GMP 品質協議視角
blocks.en: Key Notes: GMP Quality Agreement Perspective

blocks.zh: 在 PIC/S GMP Part I Chapter 7 (Outsourced Activities) 要求下，CDMO 與玻璃/橡膠/塑膠供應商之間的品質協議（Quality Agreement）必須明確載明：(1) 缺陷分類方式，(2) AQL 接受標準，(3) Limit Sample 的管理方式（版本控制、存放地點、更新週期）。這是 GMP 審計的常見查核點。
blocks.en: Under PIC/S GMP Part I Chapter 7 (Outsourced Activities), the Quality Agreement between the CDMO and glass/rubber/plastic suppliers must clearly state: (1) the defect classification method, (2) the AQL acceptance criteria, and (3) how limit samples are managed (version control, storage location, update cycle). This is a common checkpoint in GMP audits.

blocks.zh: 為何橡膠組件（活塞）的外觀缺陷標準無法直接套用工業橡膠標準？藥用場景有哪些特殊考量？
blocks.en: Why can the cosmetic defect criteria for rubber components (plunger stoppers) not simply adopt industrial rubber standards? What special considerations apply in the pharmaceutical setting?

blocks.zh: Limit Sample（界限樣品）在供應商審計中扮演什麼角色？若 Limit Sample 遺失或損壞，應如何處理？
blocks.en: What role do limit samples play in supplier audits? How should the situation be handled if a limit sample is lost or damaged?

blocks.zh: 9.2 Defect Classification 缺陷分類
blocks.en: 9.2 Defect Classification

blocks.zh: PDA TR43 五級分類體系:
blocks.en: PDA TR43 five-level classification system:

blocks.zh: Critical（致命缺陷）: 可能造成患者傷害或危害；任何損害容器完整性、可能導致無菌產品微生物污染的缺陷均屬此類。這是最高等級，通常 AQL = 0（零接受）。
blocks.en: Critical: May cause patient injury or hazard; any defect that compromises container integrity and could lead to microbial contamination of a sterile product falls into this category. This is the highest level, usually with AQL = 0 (zero acceptance).

blocks.zh: Major A（嚴重 A 缺陷）: 嚴重損害，例如使包裝無法使用的功能障礙。
blocks.en: Major A: Serious impairment, for example a functional failure that renders the package unusable.

blocks.zh: Major B（嚴重 B 缺陷）: 較輕微的損害，例如降低生產效率。
blocks.en: Major B: Less serious impairment, for example one that reduces production efficiency.

blocks.zh: Minor（輕微缺陷）: 不影響產品品質或製程能力。
blocks.en: Minor: Does not affect product quality or process capability.

blocks.zh: N/A（不適用/可接受）: 尺寸極小，屬可接受範圍，不應賦予 AQL 值。
blocks.en: N/A (not applicable / acceptable): Extremely small in size and within the acceptable range; no AQL value should be assigned.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 風險評估的整合: 缺陷分類不應單純依賴主觀判斷，而應有書面的風險評估依據（Rationale）。ICH Q9(R1) 提供了 FMEA、風險矩陣等工具，可用於系統性評估每種缺陷類型的嚴重性（Severity）、發生機率（Occurrence）及可偵測性（Detectability）。
blocks.en: Integration of ICH Q9 risk assessment: Defect classification should not rely on subjective judgement alone but should have a documented risk assessment rationale. ICH Q9(R1) provides tools such as FMEA and risk matrices that can be used to systematically assess the severity, occurrence and detectability of each defect type.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — AQL 抽樣連結
blocks.en: Key Notes: Link to AQL Sampling

blocks.zh: AQL（Acceptable Quality Level，允收品質水準）僅適用於 Critical、Major A、Major B、Minor 四個等級，N/A 類別不賦予 AQL。在台灣 CDMO 的進料抽驗實務中，通常：Critical = AQL 0（任何一件即拒收）；Major A = AQL 0.65；Major B = AQL 1.0；Minor = AQL 2.5 或 4.0。具體數值應在品質協議中與供應商明確約定，並符合 ISO 2859-1 抽樣程序要求。
blocks.en: AQL (Acceptable Quality Level) applies only to the four levels Critical, Major A, Major B and Minor; the N/A category is not assigned an AQL. In incoming inspection practice at Taiwan CDMOs, typically: Critical = AQL 0 (reject on any single unit); Major A = AQL 0.65; Major B = AQL 1.0; Minor = AQL 2.5 or 4.0. The specific values should be clearly agreed with the supplier in the Quality Agreement and comply with the ISO 2859-1 sampling procedure requirements.

blocks.zh: 這個分類體系就像交通違規的罰則分級——闖紅燈（Critical）可能造成車禍傷亡，立即吊照；超速 10 km/h（Major B）是違規但尚可管理；輕微刮傷（Minor）記錄但不影響駕駛；停車位置輕微偏差（N/A）則直接接受，不開罰單。分級的目的是讓執法資源集中在真正有風險的地方。
blocks.en: This classification system is like graded penalties for traffic violations: running a red light (Critical) may cause a fatal accident and leads to immediate license revocation; speeding by 10 km/h (Major B) is a violation but still manageable; a minor scratch (Minor) is recorded but does not affect driving; a slightly off parking position (N/A) is simply accepted with no ticket. The purpose of grading is to focus enforcement resources where the real risk lies.

blocks.zh: 一個活塞上的微小裂縫（microfissure）在 PDA TR43 框架下應歸為哪個缺陷等級？請說明理由（提示：考慮容器完整性與無菌性）。
blocks.en: Under the PDA TR43 framework, which defect level should a tiny crack (microfissure) in a plunger stopper be assigned to? Explain your reasoning (hint: consider container integrity and sterility).

blocks.zh: 在使用 ICH Q9 風險評估工具對缺陷進行分類驗證時，「Detectability（可偵測性）」這個維度對分類結果有何影響？
blocks.en: When ICH Q9 risk assessment tools are used to verify defect classification, how does the "Detectability" dimension affect the classification result?

blocks.zh: 9.3 Visual Inspection of Unfilled Syringes 未充填注射器之目視檢查
blocks.en: 9.3 Visual Inspection of Unfilled Syringes

blocks.zh: 9.3.1 Manual Visual Inspection 人工目視檢查
blocks.en: 9.3.1 Manual Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: 9.3.2 Automated Visual Inspection 自動目視檢查
blocks.en: 9.3.2 Automated Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: 9.3.1 人工目視檢查 Key Concepts
blocks.en: 9.3.1 Manual Visual Inspection: Key Concepts

blocks.zh:
兩種方法:
1. 裸眼（Naked Eye）: 速度快、成本低，但受操作者狀態影響大（疲勞、視力、經驗）
2. 放大光學系統（Magnifying Optical Systems）: 可偵測更微小缺陷，但速度慢，適用於高風險零件或樣品確認
blocks.en:
Two methods:
1. Naked eye: fast and low-cost, but strongly affected by the operator's condition (fatigue, eyesight, experience)
2. Magnifying optical systems: can detect smaller defects, but slower; suited to high-risk parts or sample confirmation

blocks.zh: 旋轉支撐（Rotating Support）的必要性: 注射器需從各角度檢視，但直接手持可能造成額外缺陷（指紋、壓力損傷）。使用 rondo tray 或 nest 托架旋轉，是同時確保全面檢視與避免引入新缺陷的標準做法。
blocks.en: Need for a rotating support: Syringes must be viewed from all angles, but holding them directly by hand may create additional defects (fingerprints, pressure damage). Using a rondo tray or nest holder for rotation is the standard practice for ensuring full inspection while avoiding the introduction of new defects.

blocks.zh: 光源配置: 白光 + 暗板（Dark Panel）的組合是標準配置。暗板背景下，容器表面的反光差異更容易揭示細微缺陷（如微裂縫、氣泡）。變光強度功能讓操作者可在不同光照條件下辨識不同性質的缺陷。
blocks.en: Lighting setup: A combination of white light and a dark panel is the standard configuration. Against a dark panel, differences in reflection on the container surface more readily reveal subtle defects (such as microcracks and bubbles). A variable light intensity function lets the operator identify defects of different natures under different lighting conditions.

blocks.zh: 9.3.2 自動目視檢查 Key Concepts
blocks.en: 9.3.2 Automated Visual Inspection: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 自動化的優勢: 減少人為誤差（Human Error），適合高速生產線。系統使用高強度聚焦光源與影像演算法，不接觸樣品即可偵測缺陷。
blocks.en: Advantages of automation: Reduces human error and suits high-speed production lines. The system uses high-intensity focused light sources and image algorithms to detect defects without touching the sample.

blocks.zh: 多區域掃描: 分別掃描注射器的側面（Lateral Surface）、底部（Bottom）、前面（Front Surface），針對不同區域設定不同的偵測靈敏度（Configurable Detection Criteria），以最佳化偵測效能。
blocks.en: Multi-zone scanning: The lateral surface, bottom and front surface of the syringe are scanned separately, with different detection sensitivities set for each zone (configurable detection criteria) to optimize detection performance.

blocks.zh: 新系統驗證要求: 新的自動偵測系統必須先進行「Failure Mode Analysis」——找出系統在哪些情況下「偵測失敗」（False Negative），而非只確認它能偵測什麼。這是設備驗證（Qualification）的核心邏輯。
blocks.en: Requirements for qualifying new systems: A new automated detection system must first undergo a "failure mode analysis" to find the situations in which the system fails to detect (false negatives), rather than only confirming what it can detect. This is the core logic of equipment qualification.

blocks.zh: 統計數據記錄: 自動系統應記錄所有統計參數，供後續報告、供應商分享或品質趨勢分析使用——這直接支援 APQR（Annual Product Quality Review）的數據需求。
blocks.en: Recording of statistical data: The automated system should record all statistical parameters for later reporting, sharing with the supplier or quality trend analysis. This directly supports the data needs of the APQR (Annual Product Quality Review).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — PIC/S Annex 1 類比
blocks.en: Key Notes: Analogy with PIC/S Annex 1

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 對充填後無菌製劑的 100% 目視檢查（Section 8.87–8.91）有詳細規定，包含光源強度、背景顏色、旋轉速度與操作者認證。本節 9.3 對「未充填注射器」的目視檢查原則與之高度一致——差別在於空針的目視檢查屬於零組件進料管控，不需符合 Annex 1 的完整要求，但相同的基本原則（足夠光照、多角度、操作者培訓）均應遵守。
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) sets out detailed requirements for 100% visual inspection of filled sterile products (Sections 8.87-8.91), including light intensity, background color, rotation speed and operator qualification. The visual inspection principles for "unfilled syringes" in this Section 9.3 are highly consistent with them. The difference is that visual inspection of empty syringes is a component incoming control and does not need to meet the full requirements of Annex 1, but the same basic principles (adequate illumination, multiple viewing angles, operator training) should be observed.

blocks.zh: 自動目視檢查系統就像機場的 X 光行李掃描機——它能快速掃描大量行李，但系統設計者必須先確認：「什麼樣的刀具掃描機會『看不見』？」（False Negative 分析）。只知道系統能看見什麼是不夠的，更重要的是知道它的盲點在哪裡，然後用補充措施（人工複驗、抽樣確認）填補那些盲點。
blocks.en: An automated visual inspection system is like an X-ray baggage scanner at an airport: it can quickly scan large volumes of luggage, but the system designers must first confirm "which knives would the scanner fail to see?" (false negative analysis). Knowing only what the system can see is not enough; it is more important to know where its blind spots are, and to fill those blind spots with supplementary measures (manual re-inspection, sampling confirmation).

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application — Taiwan CDMO
blocks.en: Practical Application: Taiwan CDMO

blocks.zh: Amaran 等 sterile fill-finish CDMO 在評估新玻璃供應商時，應要求供應商提供其自動目視檢查系統的驗證報告（AVI Qualification Report），確認：(1) 系統偵測的缺陷類型覆蓋 TR43 各分類；(2) 已進行 Worst-Case 挑戰測試（Challenge Test），確認 False Negative 率在可接受範圍內；(3) 統計輸出格式可與 CDMO 的品質系統整合，支援趨勢分析。
blocks.en: When evaluating a new glass supplier, a sterile fill-finish CDMO such as Amaran should ask the supplier for the qualification report of its automated visual inspection system (AVI Qualification Report) and confirm that: (1) the defect types detected by the system cover all TR43 classifications; (2) worst-case challenge testing has been performed and the false negative rate is within an acceptable range; (3) the statistical output format can be integrated with the CDMO's quality system to support trend analysis.

blocks.zh: 人工目視檢查中，「暗板背景（Dark Panel）」能幫助偵測哪類缺陷？白光背景無法有效偵測的缺陷類型是什麼？
blocks.en: In manual visual inspection, what types of defects does the dark panel background help detect? Which defect types cannot be effectively detected against a white background?

blocks.zh: 自動目視檢查系統驗證時，為何「False Negative（漏偵）分析」比「True Positive（正確偵測）確認」更為關鍵？請從患者安全的角度說明。
blocks.en: When qualifying an automated visual inspection system, why is "false negative (missed detection) analysis" more critical than "true positive (correct detection) confirmation"? Explain from the patient safety perspective.

blocks.zh: 若供應商使用自動目視檢查，藥廠使用人工目視檢查進行進料抽驗，可能出現哪些爭議情境？如何在品質協議中預防？
blocks.en: If the supplier uses automated visual inspection while the pharmaceutical company uses manual visual inspection for incoming sampling, what disputes may arise? How can they be prevented in the Quality Agreement?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 範疇（Scope）: Section 9 聚焦於未充填 PFS 的視覺缺陷管理，不含尺寸、印刷、包裝缺陷。外觀缺陷的累積效應會直接影響充填後最終目視檢查的良率，未偵測的嚴重缺陷可危及患者安全。
blocks.en: Scope: Section 9 focuses on the management of visual defects of unfilled PFS, excluding dimensional, printing and packaging defects. The cumulative effect of cosmetic imperfections directly affects the yield of final visual inspection after filling, and undetected serious defects can endanger patient safety.

blocks.zh: 缺陷識別（Section 9.1）: PDA TR43 提供玻璃零件的缺陷識別框架；橡膠與塑膠組件目前無藥學專用標準。供應商與藥廠須協議接受標準並建立 Limit Samples，並對齊識別方法（人工 vs. 自動）。
blocks.en: Defect identification (Section 9.1): PDA TR43 provides the defect identification framework for glass parts; there is currently no pharmaceutical-specific standard for rubber and plastic components. Supplier and pharmaceutical company must agree acceptance criteria, establish limit samples and align the identification method (manual vs. automated).

blocks.zh: 缺陷分類（Section 9.2）: PDA TR43 五級分類——Critical / Major A / Major B / Minor / N/A。Critical 缺陷影響容器完整性，AQL 通常為零。N/A 不賦予 AQL。ICH Q9 風險評估方法應用於分類驗證，確保有書面依據。
blocks.en: Defect classification (Section 9.2): The PDA TR43 five levels: Critical / Major A / Major B / Minor / N/A. Critical defects affect container integrity, and the AQL is usually zero. N/A is not assigned an AQL. ICH Q9 risk assessment methods are applied to verify the classification and ensure a documented rationale.

blocks.zh: 人工目視檢查（Section 9.3.1）: 裸眼或放大光學系統，需搭配旋轉支撐、白光源與暗板，操作者須定期培訓。操作者的資格與經驗是人工檢查品質的關鍵變數。
blocks.en: Manual visual inspection (Section 9.3.1): Naked eye or magnifying optical systems, combined with a rotating support, white light source and dark panel; operators require regular training. Operator qualification and experience are the key variables for the quality of manual inspection.

blocks.zh: 自動目視檢查（Section 9.3.2）: 高強度聚焦光源 + 影像演算法，多區域掃描（側面、底部、前面），可配置各區域偵測靈敏度。新系統須先分析其「偵測失敗」情境（False Negative 分析）。系統應記錄所有統計參數以支援品質趨勢分析。
blocks.en: Automated visual inspection (Section 9.3.2): High-intensity focused light source + image algorithms, multi-zone scanning (lateral surface, bottom, front), with configurable detection sensitivity per zone. A new system must first be analyzed for its "failure to detect" scenarios (false negative analysis). The system should record all statistical parameters to support quality trend analysis.
